clan.name: Lords of War
clan.description: Who Are We?We are LoW!Resistance is Futile!.Not a relic of the past, but a storm of the present! We dominated GvG like no other, holding Top 1 for 2013 days. Throughout our history, we set major milestones – creating the 1st level 80 Arc in FoE and becoming the 1st guild where every member had a level 80 Arc.Our cause is simple – to be the best of the best.What Do We Offer?Stability – We've been here since 2012, and LoW isn’t going anywhere.Excellence – We represent the finest players on EN7 who keep raising the bar.Teamwork – We work as one and always have each other's backs.Growth – An environment where newbies, intermediates, and veterans can learn, grow, and level up.Equality – Every member matters – everyone contributes to our success.Benefits – We offer BE GB support, Arc leveling incentives, and as a level 100 guild, the best daily FP, construction, and recruitment bonuses.Innovation – We stay ahead of the game, sharing knowledge and improving as a team.Requirements:Era: We accept players from All Era's except LMAArc: Level 80 minimum (ideally Arc 100; we have a BE for All GB's thread and 2.0 for Arcs thread)Guild Goods: Must be working toward:Indy/PE/ME: 2000/dayFE, AF, OF, VF: 2500/daySAM, SAAB, SAV, SAJM: 3000/daySAT: 3500/dayGE: Level 80 is a must on competitive weeksGBG: We do not care how active you are on off seasons, only on competitive matches where we expect you to step up and be maximally activeQI: Minimum 4000 pointsHow to Apply:If you wanna join Lords of War, create a thread and send a group message to everyone with a Crown & a Star.

clan.description: Who Are We?We are LoW!Resistance is Futile!.Not a relic of the past, but a storm of the present! We dominated GvG like no other, holding Top 1 for 2013 days. clan.description: Lords of War Vets is an exclusive Guild for former Lords of War players who are no longer playing Forge of Empires or are rarely active. Only former Lords of War players are permitted access to this retirement home.Welcome to Lords of War, the most prestigious team of Guilds on Greifental. Would you like to be a part of this great team?.. fight and help win major wars?.. know that your trades will be met and your citizens will be happy?.. develop your game efficiently and have the satisfaction of reaching your full game potential?We are currently recruiting but places are limited.----------------------------What do we offer?1. Stability - We have been here since 2012 and our Guild will continue to be successful.2. Excellence - We represent the finest players on EN7 who set new standards for this game and have held the top Guild position, almost exclusively.3. Teamwork - We work together as one to achieve goals - we trade fairly and aid Guild members frequently.4. Growth - We provide an environment where early, intermediate and advanced players can develop.5. Tactics - We focus on inventing and evolving tactics to maintain a dominant Guild position.6. Equality - Our players are treated equally - everyone contributes in a possitive way to our mutual success.7. Benefits - LOW has the best FPs/day and construction discounts of all guilds on EN7.----------------------------LOW & LOW Rangers requirements1. All players are required to take a specific role in the guild. Two roles are available for new recruits - fighter or producer. More roles are available for senior players.2. For fighters we expect basic army buildings, a high level of activity and teamwork. You should have Alcatraz, Rogue Hideout and 3 GBs with attack bonus. We expect you to join our Skype chat and help us with GvG when your time permits. We might require you to build specific army buildings for military actions.3. clan.description: In Canada we accept people from all around the world eh.Hi and Welcome to CanadiansWe are a pretty relaxed group; we like to keep the peace eh? So there's not so much in the way of rules per say, rather a mutually beneficial agreement to be fair to each other. And a few explanations about how things work such as: - Fair Trades - are 1:1 for the same Era, 1:2 for ONE lower Era and 2:1 for ONE higher Era. "Even Fairer" trades would offer a little more than necessary like 110 goods for 100 same era, or offering more than one era higher goods (that you happen to have lots of) to get lower era goods you are desparate for, or just to help out. That's when you want to check the box to make it only available to your guildmates.   - In The Mud - or in sticks or muddy all refer to brand new Great Buildings and you should post all new GBs as soon as you build them in "In The Mud for New Great Buildings" thread and everyone should chip in and help build the first few levels to help them on their way.   - We hope everyone aids everyone every day but real life gets in the way sometimes so please try your best.  - And please try to let someone know like a Leader or Founder if you will be away more than a week or you might get the autokick.  - The Donate First Threads - like "DONATE 10 fp GET 10fp Great Buildings" thread means you must donate the required 10FPs to the last one posted FIRST and THEN post yours for someone to donate to.- Sniping - is not allowed in the guild. Putting a small amount like one or two Forge Points in someone's Great Building hoping for a big payback, which is obviously not mutually beneficial, and while it may be ok to try to cheat your weaker neighbours it could start feuds with stronger ones and friends will drop you for it and most guilds have strict policies against sniping your fellow guildies.  - Buildings that help the Guild like the Arc, Atomium and Observatory are, in many guilds, required for entry, as are participation in the Guild Expedition, Guild BattleGrounds and Guild vs Guild Map. We haven't been doing the GVG map and we don't insist on the buildings but we can help get them built if you need. But we would like to see everyone doing some of the Guild Expedition and Guild BattleGrounds because this helps the guild standings a lot and they give great rewards back too.  - If you have any questions just ask in Q & A thread.  - So everyone be nice and try to help out and we all will have fun.  Happy Building!!

In Buddhist & Hindu traditions it can translate as "the path to peace". "Dharmakshetra" is the name of an Indian TV series based around a celestial court pondering the mythic ancient indian battle of Mahabharata where 1.66 billion people died.  The Mahabharata is one of the longest epic poems ever written. It has over 200,000 verse lines, 1.8 million words and it is believed that it could have taken over 600 years to write! The oldest surviving piece of text is believed to be dated from 400BCE. TV series (can be found on youtube) is *terrible* but the the story is of special interest to moral philosophers.
